facts.fact: A demographic update (name, gender, date of birth, address, mobile number, email) costs Rs 75 when done separately
facts.quote: (2) Demographic update: Update of enrolled name, gender, date of birth, address, mobile number or email address, or any combination of the same (i) If done at the same time with biometric update: Free (ii) If done separately: ₹75

facts.fact: A demographic update is free when done at the same time as a biometric update
facts.quote: (2) Demographic update: Update of enrolled name, gender, date of birth, address, mobile number or email address, or any combination of the same (i) If done at the same time with biometric update: Free (ii) If done separately: ₹75
facts.note: The fee sheet uploaded 2026-09 on backend.uidai.gov.in lists only 'If done separately: ₹75' for demographic update and drops the 'Free with biometric update' line; the Aadhaar Seva Kendra page and the other fee-sheet copies still show it.

facts.fact: A biometric update is free the first time between ages 5 and 7
facts.quote: (i) If done first time between the age of 5 to 7 years: Free#

facts.fact: A biometric update is free the first or second time between ages 15 and 17
facts.quote: (ii) If done first or second time between the age of 15 to 17 years: Free#

facts.fact: The free mandatory biometric updates must be stand-alone transactions
facts.quote: # Mandatory Biometric Update (MBU) shall be stand-alone transaction only; it may not be clubbed with any other transaction

facts.fact: Otherwise a biometric update costs Rs 125
UIDAI extended the fee waiver for the first mandatory biometric update (MBU-1) of children aged 7 to 15 by one year from 1.10.2026, so it stays free till 30.09.2027
facts.was: the extra free window for ages 7-15 ended on 30.9.2026
facts.quote: UIDAI has granted extension of waiver of MBU-1 charges payable by an Aadhaar number holder aged 7 - 15 years, for an additional period of one year, w.e.f. 1.10.2026. Thus, the MBU-1 service shall remain free of cost to the children (aged 7-15 years) till 30.09.2027.
facts.note: UIDAI Office Memorandum on extension of the MBU-1 fee waiver, uploaded 25-09-2026 (as in Q-004). The fee-sheet PDF on uidai.gov.in/images (and its 2026-05 copy) still prints 30.9.2026 and is out of date.

facts.fact: The Aadhaar Seva Kendra page also shows the update as free for ages 7 to 15 till 30.9.2027
facts.quote: (*If done between the age of 7 to 15 years: Free, till 30.9.2027)

facts.fact: A document update (proof of identity/address) is free on the myAadhaar portal till 14.06.2027
A document update costs Rs 75 at an Aadhaar centre
facts.quote: (i) At Aadhaar centre: ₹75 (ii) Using myAadhaar portal ( https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/du ): Free (till 14.06.2027)

behaviour: Gives each fee from UIDAI's fee sheet / Aadhaar Seva Kendra page, citing uidai.gov.in, including that the first mandatory biometric update for children aged 7 to 15 stays free till 30.09.2027 (UIDAI extended the waiver; extension OM or Aadhaar Seva Kendra page).
fail_if: Any amount differs (Rs 75 demographic update done separately, Rs 125 biometric update, Rs 75 document update at a centre); the 14.06.2027 date for free online document update is missing; it says the 7-15 waiver has ended or gives 30.9.2026 as its end as if it were current; it cites no UIDAI page.
summary: Fees confirmed (Rs 75 / Rs 125 / document update free online till 14.06.2027, Rs 75 at centre); changed: UIDAI OM (uploaded 25-09-2026) extended the free MBU-1 for ages 7-15 till 30.09.2027, so the old 'ended on 30.9.2026' is out of date.
